cues.en: So I have a question for you. Off the top of your head, could you sing any music from Star Wars? How about James Bond?
cues.zh: 我想问大家一个问题。不假思索的话，你能哼出《Star Wars》里的任何音乐吗？那《James Bond》呢？

cues.en: Harry Potter My last question Can you sing anything from a Marvel movie? I'm like the biggest Marvel fan that I know of I just I can't think of any of the songs
cues.zh: 《Harry Potter》呢？我最后一个问题：你能哼出漫威电影里的任何音乐吗？我可以说是我认识的人里最大的漫威粉了，可我就是想不起里面的任何一首歌。

cues.en: Why is this? Because the Marvel Cinematic Universe is now the highest grossing franchise in film history. More than Star Wars, more than James Bond, more than Harry Potter. So what is missing from their music?
cues.zh: 这是为什么呢？因为漫威电影宇宙现在是影史上票房最高的系列。超过了《Star Wars》，超过了《James Bond》，也超过了《Harry Potter》。那么，他们的配乐到底缺少了什么？

cues.en: The first problem is that most of the music doesn't evoke an emotional response. Take a look at this scene from the first Iron Man. It's kind of hard to hear it. So let's try that one more time. But this time, with just the music, isolated. Did you have an emotional reaction to that music?
cues.zh: 第一个问题是，大部分音乐无法唤起情绪共鸣。看看第一部《Iron Man》里的这个场景。配乐有点听不大清。我们再试一次。但这一次，单独把音乐剥离出来听。听这段音乐时，你有情绪波动吗？

cues.en: So what happens to this scene if we just take it out? The scene works just fine, and it doesn't need any other sound. And that's partially why you forget the music. It's like the air conditioner in the background. After a while, you tune it out. Another problem is that the music is used very predictably.
cues.zh: 如果我们把配乐拿掉，这个场景会怎么样？这场戏看起来毫无问题，根本不需要多余的声音。这就是为什么大家容易忘记这些音乐的部分原因。它就像背景里的空调声。时间一长，你就会自动忽略它。另一个问题是，音乐用得太循规蹈矩了。

cues.en: so that what you see is what you get. If you see something funny, you hear funny music. If you see something sad, you hear a high note on the strings. This is a really safe way to score a film, because all of the emotions are expected. The music just tells you the same thing as the picture. If someone looks scared, then you hear. And this is the second reason the music is forgettable. It never challenges your expectations. But sometimes, the Marvel films do have memorable music. Except the filmmakers don't let us listen to it.
cues.zh: 也就是所谓的所见即所听。如果你看到搞笑的画面，就会听到滑稽的音乐。如果你看到悲伤的画面，就会听到弦乐的高音。这是一种非常稳妥的配乐方式，因为所有的情绪都在预料之中。画面演什么，音乐就重复传达什么。如果有人看起来很害怕，你就会听到紧张的音效。这是配乐容易被遗忘的第二个原因。它从不打破你的预期。但有时候，漫威电影里确实也有让人难忘的配乐。只是电影制作人不让我们好好去听。

cues.en: Instead, they cover it up with other sounds, like this. That narrator is just telling us things we already know. And he distracts us from the emotion of the scene. So how does this moment play without that distraction? Did you feel the difference?
cues.zh: 相反，他们用其他声音把音乐盖住了，就像这样。那个旁白只是在复述我们早就知道的事情。而且他分散了我们对场景情绪的注意力。那么，去掉这种干扰后，这一刻的感觉如何呢？感受到差异了吗？

cues.en: Film music is incredibly subjective and it goes through trends. And over the last 20 years, there's been a cultural shift. Nowadays, a lot of filmmakers feel that music should not be noticed. That's a contemporary thing that I've heard very frequently. It's not supposed to be noticed. Right. But why is it not supposed to be noticed? I grew up on Alfred Hitchcock's films, Bernard Herman, and I noticed every note. I find it a little bit baffling why that seems to be the consciousness of
cues.zh: 电影配乐主观性极强，也有其时代潮流。在过去的20年里，发生了一种文化转变。如今，很多电影制作人认为配乐不应该引人注意。这是我近期非常频繁听到的一种现代观点。“它本就不该引人注目。”没错。但为什么它不该被注意到呢？我是看着 Alfred Hitchcock 的电影、听着 Bernard Herrmann 长大的，我能注意到里面的每一个音符。我有点想不通，为什么现在对电影音乐的认知

cues.en: music and film. But there is one thing we haven't mentioned yet, and it's very important. Today, blockbuster movie scores are composed through a particular process. And that process starts with one controversial element. Danny, you groaned earlier when someone mentioned temp music, the pros and cons. For me, temp music is the bane of my existence. It's my job to make the director forget everything he's heard in the temp. I won't listen to it.
cues.zh: 会变成这样。不过还有一点我们还没提到，而且非常重要。如今，大片配乐是通过一套特定的流程创作出来的。而这个流程始于一个颇具争议的环节。Danny，刚才有人提到临时配乐（temp music）的优缺点时，你叹了口气。对我来说，临时配乐简直是我的一生之敌。我的工作就是让导演彻底忘掉他在临时配乐里听到的所有东西。我根本不会去听它。

cues.en: but once, I'll never listen to it twice. And if they're addicted to it, it's just going to make my job harder. Let's back up a second. Temp music is when you're editing a film and you take music from another movie and use it temporarily in your cut, like this. Temp music is always supposed to be replaced by a composer's original score. But sometimes directors or producers will tell their composer to imitate the temp. To our knowledge, this is the only time a studio has publicly apologized
cues.zh: 但只听一次，我绝不会听第二遍。如果他们对此上瘾，只会让我的工作更难。我们先倒回去一点。临时配乐是指你在剪辑电影时，从另一部电影里拿音乐，临时放进你的剪辑里，就像这样。临时配乐本应总是被作曲家的原创配乐替换。但有时导演或制片人会告诉作曲家去模仿临时配乐。据我们所知，这是唯一一次有制片厂公开道歉

cues.en: for imitating temp music. But the far more pervasive effect is that now, most blockbusters are temped with each other's scores. So they kind of sound like each other, but just within legal limits. And as the Marvel franchise has become more popular, now other films sound like they were temped with Marvel music. We want to emphasize, we're not blaming the composers. Things don't get this way unless it's systemic. Before temp music became popular, directors would often reference other music as a way to talk to the composer.
cues.zh: 原因是模仿临时配乐。但更普遍的影响是，现在大多数大片都拿彼此的配乐来做临时配乐。所以它们听起来有点像，但刚好在合法范围内。随着漫威系列越来越受欢迎，现在其他电影听起来就像是用漫威音乐做临时配乐。我们想强调，我们不是在怪作曲家。事情不会变成这样，除非它是系统性的。在临时配乐流行之前，导演常常引用其他音乐，作为和作曲家沟通的方式。

cues.en: But what changed everything was modern non-linear editing, which allowed a director to put their favorite music in the movie and have the editor cut to it. Now, a director points to the temp and says, make it like that. And it's not because the music is the right choice, but because they've listened to it.
cues.zh: 但改变一切的是现代非线性剪辑，它让导演可以把自己喜欢的音乐放进电影里，让剪辑师跟着它剪。现在，导演指着临时配乐说：就做成那样。这不是因为那段音乐是正确选择，而是因为他们已经听惯了它。

cues.en: Again and again and again for hours and hours and making the new DVD they watch at home when they go back and then another version the next day with the same music and at some point the music sticks to the picture. They could spend a year with it before you arrive. By the way when you take that music out often the cut isn't right because they're cutting to something but it's very frustrating. Part of the frustration is that filmmakers just reuse things that worked in every other movie.
cues.zh: 一遍又一遍，一连好几个小时；他们回家后看成片的新 DVD，第二天又做一个同样音乐的版本，到某个时候，音乐就黏在画面上了。在你进组之前，他们可能已经和这段音乐相处了一年。顺便说一句，当你把那段音乐拿掉，剪辑往往就不对了，因为他们是跟着某个东西剪的，这非常令人沮丧。沮丧的一部分原因是，电影人只是重复使用在其他每部电影里都奏效的东西。

cues.en: so you end up with the lowest common denominator. Remember this? Let's try something different. So, earlier in the film, Thor convinced his friends to do something illegal, and he was banished. Now, they're doing something illegal to find him. He's not asking for their help, they're giving it willingly. What if we heard this feeling in the music? We're not saying this is the right choice here, but it's worth trying out, because it makes the scene emotionally richer.
cues.zh: 所以最后得到的就是最低共同标准。还记得这个吗？我们试试不同的做法。在影片前面，索尔说服朋友们做了违法的事，然后他被放逐了。现在，他们为了找他也做了违法的事。他不是在求他们帮忙，他们是自愿的。如果我们在音乐里听到这种情绪会怎样？我们不是说这里这就是正确选择，但值得一试，因为它让这场戏在情感上更丰富。

cues.en: And all of the choices you see in Marvel films, the background noise, hearing what you see, adding a narrator, temp music, all of these stem from the same desire, to keep things safe. This is not bad music, it's just bland and inoffensive. And because Marvel sacrifices emotional richness for these safe choices, the end result is this.
cues.zh: 而你在漫威电影里看到的所有选择——背景噪音、所见即所听、加旁白、临时配乐——都源于同一种欲望：让一切保持安全。这不是糟糕的音乐，只是平淡、不得罪人。而因为漫威为了这些安全选择牺牲了情感丰富度，最终结果就是这样。

cues.en: So what is missing from Marvel music? Risk. The kind of risk that creates an emotional connection with the audience so that they carry the music with them. People do not remember safe choices. Only bold, original music can do this. But that being said, we did find one Marvel theme that still got this reaction.
cues.zh: 那么 Marvel 的音乐到底缺少了什么？是冒险。这种冒险能与观众产生情感共鸣，让他们久久难忘。循规蹈矩的选择不会被人记住。唯有大胆且独创的音乐才能做到这一点。话虽如此，我们确实发现了一首依然能引起这种反响的 Marvel 主题曲。

cues.en: Here comes Spider-Man. That's Izzie Strong. Listen bud, he's got radioactive blood. Can he swing on a web? Check the luck overhead. Hey there, there goes Spider-Man. In the chill of night, at the scene of a crime. Like a stream of light, he arrives just in time. Spider-Man, Spider-Man, friendly neighborhood Spider-Man. Welcome friends, he's ignored.
cues.zh: Spider-Man 来了。那正是 Izzie Strong。听着伙计，他体内流淌着放射性血液。他能荡着蛛丝飞跃吗？瞧瞧头顶上的身手吧。嘿瞧啊，Spider-Man 飞过去了。在寒冷的夜晚，在犯罪的现场。宛如一束光芒，他总是及时登场。Spider-Man，Spider-Man，大家的好邻居 Spider-Man。无视赞誉，淡然处之。

cues.en: action is his reward to him life is a great big hang up wherever there's a bang up you'll find the spider-man that was incredible thank you so much
cues.zh: 行动就是他的奖赏，对他而言生活总有解不开的结，哪里有骚乱，哪里就有 Spider-Man。太精彩了，非常感谢大家。
